title: Step Back to Move Forward: Reflection-Aware Preference Optimization for Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion models have become the mainstream paradigm for modern visual generation and have substantially advanced multimedia content synthesis, especially in text-to-image and text-to-video tasks. To further align such generative models with human preferences, reinforcement learning (RL) has recently shown strong potential as a post-training strategy. Nevertheless, existing policy gradient-based methods often explore inefficiently, making them vulnerable to local optima that may degrade semantic faithfulness and visual realism. To address these challenges, we present Reflection-Aware GRPO (RA-GRPO), a new RL-based preference alignment framework for diffusion generative models. The core idea is to improve "forward" generation by incorporating "backward" reflection during optimization. We first introduce Diffusion Reflection, which rectifies intermediate sampling trajectories by inverting the diffusion process with a weak estimator, guiding latent states toward higher-probability regions of the true data manifold. Furthermore, we introduce Counterfactual Path Synthesis to implicitly distill these rectified trajectories into the policy, enabling the model to internalize the benefits of search-based exploration without incurring inference-time overhead. Extensive experiments on T2I and T2V models demonstrate that RA-GRPO significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly in mitigating reward hacking and improving generalization. The method remains architecture-agnostic and integrates seamlessly with standard pipelines, suggesting a promising direction for stable preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RA-GRPO，一种基于强化学习的扩散生成模型偏好对齐框架，通过"反向反思"机制改进前向生成过程，利用扩散反转和反事实路径合成提升训练效率，在T2I和T2V任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有政策梯度方法在扩散模型的偏好对齐中探索效率低下，容易陷入局部最优，导致语义保真度和视觉真实感下降。
AI.method: 提出两种核心机制：(1) Diffusion Reflection—通过弱估计器反转扩散过程来修正中间采样轨迹，引导隐状态朝向真实数据流形的高概率区域；(2) Counterfactual Path Synthesis—将修正后的轨迹隐式蒸馏到策略中，使模型内化基于搜索的探索收益而无需推理时额外开销。
AI.result: 在T2I和T2V模型上大量实验表明，RA-GRPO显著优于现有方法，尤其在缓解奖励作弊和提升泛化能力方面表现突出；方法具有架构无关性，可无缝集成到标准流程中。
AI.conclusion: RA-GRPO为扩散生成模型的稳定偏好对齐提供了有前景的方向，通过反思机制有效解决了RL探索效率低的问题。

title: Joint Alignment and Distillation for Video Generation via Sample-Guided Distribution Matching
summary: Aligning video generative models to human preferences heavily relies on Reinforcement Learning (RL), which suffers from extensive computational overhead. Existing workflows typically treat RL and distillation as disconnected stages: applying RL before distillation incurs prohibitive computational costs, whereas applying RL after distillation frequently leads to model collapse. To overcome these limitations, we propose a unified, single-stage optimization framework grounded in Distribution Matching (DM). In the standard DM framework, distillation updates the model via a gradient direction that minimizes the gap between the real and fake models, guiding generations toward clarity and high fidelity. Building upon this, we introduce DM-Align, which derives a complementary gradient direction to guide the model toward human-preferred samples. Inspired by DPO and GRPO, our method leverages the distributional gap -- formulated from either preference pairs or intra-group exploration -- to directly construct this preference-guided gradient. By synergizing these two gradient directions, our approach eliminates the need for multi-step reward evaluation and complex ODE-SDE conversions inherent in traditional RL. Comprehensive experiments across multiple foundational video models demonstrate that this sample-guided framework robustly enhances both distillation quality and preference alignment, consistently outperforming both standalone variants and sequential two-stage pipelines.

interest_filter.reason: 该论文提出DM-Align，一个基于分布匹配的统一单阶段优化框架，用于视频生成模型的偏好对齐与蒸馏，涵盖了视频生成基础模型的蒸馏（通过扩散模型蒸馏减少计算开销但保持保真度）和偏好对齐优化。论文实验基于多个基础视频模型展开，与用户关注的"视频生成基础模型"和"实时视频生成"（蒸馏方向相关，旨在高效率生成）密切相关，属于直接应用与子主题。

AI.tldr: 提出DM-Align，一个统一的单阶段优化框架，基于分布匹配（DM）同时优化视频生成模型的蒸馏质量和人类偏好对齐，消除传统RL中多步奖励评估和ODE-SDE转换的开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型对齐人类偏好的方法依赖强化学习（RL），计算开销巨大。传统的"先RL后蒸馏"或"先蒸馏后RL"两阶段流程要么代价过高，要么导致模型崩溃，缺乏单阶段统一优化方案。
AI.method: 在标准分布匹配（DM）框架中，蒸馏梯度用于缩小真实与生成模型间的分布差距；DM-Align在此基础上推导出互补的偏好引导梯度，借鉴DPO和GRPO的思路，利用偏好对或组内探索构建的分布差距来直接构造偏好引导梯度，二者协同实现单阶段优化。
AI.result: 在多个基础视频模型上的综合实验表明，该框架在蒸馏质量和偏好对齐两方面均有稳健提升，持续优于单独的变体方法和顺序两阶段流水线。
AI.conclusion: DM-Align证明通过单一阶段的样本引导框架即可同时实现蒸馏质量提升和人类偏好对齐，为视频生成模型的对齐优化提供了一种无需复杂RL流程的高效替代方案。

title: ReaDiT Guidance: Control for Image and Video Generation using Diffusion Transformer Features
summary: We present DiT Readout (ReaDiT) Guidance, a lightweight framework for controlling generation with Diffusion Transformer (DiT) models via their internal feature representations. ReaDiT Guidance uses features from a single DiT block to steer the generative process according to spatial targets - like depth, pose, or edge maps - provided at test time. Furthermore, since modern text-to-video models are largely built on DiT backbones, ReaDiT Guidance naturally extends to video generation, enabling camera and motion control. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive or improved results compared to existing feature-based and off-the-shelf adapter-based approaches while requiring fewer parameters.

interest_filter.reason: 该论文提出ReaDiT Guidance框架，利用扩散Transformer的内部特征来控制图像和视频生成，涉及图像生成基础模型和视频生成基础模型领域，符合用户对图像生成和视频生成的兴趣。

AI.tldr: 提出ReaDiT Guidance，一种轻量级框架，通过读取DiT模型的内部特征表示来控制生成过程，支持深度图、姿态、边缘图等空间目标约束，并可自然扩展到视频生成实现相机和运动控制，以更少的参数达到或超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成控制方法通常需要额外的适配器或大量参数，作者希望利用DiT模型内部已有的特征表示来构建轻量级的引导机制，避免引入额外网络开销。
AI.method: 从单个DiT块中读取内部特征（即ReaDiT），利用这些特征在测试时间将生成过程向给定的空间目标（深度、姿态、边缘等）进行引导。由于现代文生视频模型大多基于DiT骨干，该方法可自然扩展至视频生成，实现相机视角和运动控制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，ReaDiT Guidance在生成质量和控制精度方面达到或超越了现有的基于特征的方法和即插即用的适配器方法，同时所需参数量更少。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过DiT模型内部特征即可实现高效、轻量的生成控制，为图像和视频等多模态生成任务的引导提供了一个简洁且通用的解决方案。

title: TourPhysics: Bringing Physics to World Models for Exploration and Manipulation from a Single Image
summary: Interactive visual world models must distinguish observation from physical intervention. Camera motion reveals new surfaces, whereas intervention changes object motion, contact, and deformation. Current video world models are largely driven by appearance priors and often lose physical or spatial consistency over long horizons. We present TourPhysics, an online framework initialized from a single image and a declarative physical configuration. TourPhysics extends PhysOmni, our ACM Multimedia 2026 work, from finite physics-grounded video synthesis to persistent exploration and manipulation. TourPhysics combines deterministic simulation with video generation while assigning separate roles to simulator state, geometric evidence, generator controls, and appearance memory. For each action, the simulator computes a finite physical and camera trajectory before the corresponding observation is generated. Accepted observations publish the terminal state and update the appearance memory and subsequent generator controls, while the committed state and simulator geometry remain fixed throughout synthesis and retry. We further separate the simulator geometry used for projection and visibility from the relative depth used to condition the generator. A reference-anchored memory retrieves accepted static appearance through geometric cross-view correspondence and incorporates it through a bounded residual that reverts to the native path when no valid correspondence exists. On simulator-defined camera tours and object manipulations, TourPhysics follows prescribed camera and object trajectories more closely than the evaluated baselines, preserves the input scene, and reduces appearance drift during long-horizon revisits.

interest_filter.reason: 该论文提出TourPhysics框架，将从单张图像出发的物理信息驱动视频世界模型用于持续性探索与操作，结合视频生成与确定性模拟，属于交互式视频生成和视频生成基础模型的直接研究方向，与用户兴趣高度匹配。

AI.tldr: TourPhysics是一个从单张图像和声明式物理配置初始化的在线交互式视觉世界模型框架，通过结合确定性仿真与视频生成，实现持久探索和操作，增强物理与空间一致性并减少外观漂移。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型主要依赖外观先验，在长时间序列中缺乏物理一致性和空间一致性，且无法区分观察（相机运动）与物理干预（物体运动/接触/变形）带来的变化。
AI.method: TourPhysics扩展了PhysOmni，将仿真器状态、几何证据、生成器控制和外观记忆分离角色。对每个动作，仿真器先计算有限物理与相机轨迹，再生成对应观测；已接受的观测发布终端状态并更新外观记忆与后续生成器控制，而提交状态和仿真器几何在合成与重试过程中保持固定。此外，将用于投影和可见性的仿真器几何与用于条件生成器的相对深度分离，并通过参考锚定记忆检索跨视图对应关系，以有界残差方式整合静态外观。
AI.result: 在仿真器定义的相机巡游和物体操作任务中，TourPhysics比基线方法更紧密地遵循预设的相机和物体轨迹，保持输入场景不变，并在长时程重访中显著减少外观漂移。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物理仿真的确定性约束与视频生成的灵活性相结合，并明确分离各组件职能，TourPhysics实现了更具物理与空间一致性的持久交互式视觉世界建模。

title: WeAgent-MMGenEdit: A Full-Stack Recipe for Multimodal Agentic Image Generation and Editing
summary: Image generation and editing models have advanced rapidly, yet remain unreliable when prompts require external world knowledge. Bounded and long-tail parametric knowledge prevents direct or reason-then-generate approaches from recovering the required facts and visual appearances. Existing agentic generation and editing methods mitigate this limitation with retrieval tools, yet remain constrained by insufficient visual verification, overloaded policy models, and weak integration of retrieved textual and visual evidence. To address these limitations, we present WeAgent-MMGenEdit, a full-stack recipe including a multimodal harness, a scalable data construction pipeline, a comprehensive benchmark, and post-training methods for the agent policy and image backend. We first introduce WeAgent-Harness, a multimodal runtime with persistent evidence management and dedicated verification and integration tools that organize retrieved multimodal evidence into a dense carrier. Upon this, we develop a scalable pipeline for prompt synthesis and agentic trajectory collection, yielding 23K supervised trajectories and 14.7K RL tasks with three-layer verifiable checklists. We further introduce WeBench-MMGenEdit, a bilingual benchmark covering both knowledge-intensive image generation and multi-image editing. Finally, a two-sided post-training recipe based on SFT and RL improves the agent policy and image backend. Together, WeAgent-MMGenEdit enables a 30B-total/3B-active policy to outperform similarly sized policy models and approach the performance of a 1T-parameter agent.

interest_filter.reason: 该论文聚焦于多模态智能体驱动的图像生成与编辑，属于图像生成基础模型的直接相关子方向（agentic image generation and editing），包含图像生成后端优化、多模态证据整合等核心内容，与用户"图像生成基础模型"兴趣高度匹配。

AI.motivation: 现有图像生成与编辑模型在处理需要外部世界知识的提示时不可靠，参数化知识有限且长尾，已有的智能体方法受限于视觉验证不足、策略模型过载以及文本与视觉证据整合薄弱等问题。
AI.method: 提出全栈方案：(1) WeAgent-Harness多模态运行时，具备持久证据管理和专用验证与整合工具，组织多模态证据为密集载体；(2) 可扩展的提示合成与智能体轨迹收集管线，产出23K监督轨迹和14.7K强化学习任务（含三层可验证清单）；(3) 双语基准WeBench-MMGenEdit，覆盖知识密集型图像生成和多图像编辑；(4) 基于SFT和RL的双侧后训练方法，同时优化智能体策略和图像后端。
AI.result: WeAgent-MMGenEdit使得30B总参数/3B激活参数的策略模型超越相同规模模型，并接近1T参数智能体的性能水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过将检索工具、双向验证机制和完整的智能体基础设施结合，能够有效弥合大语言模型在知识密集型图像任务中的能力差距，实现高效的小参数智能体逼近超大模型的性能。
